audience: businesses that send printed direct mail with Click2Mail

useCases.title: Check your credit and estimate the cost of a mailing
useCases.text: The AI reads the account credit, the mail products and valid options, and estimates the cost of a mailing from its print options and quantity. Nothing is created or charged.

useCases.title: Find a mailing job and follow its USPS tracking
useCases.text: The AI lists your projects and the jobs of one project, reads the status of a job, and reads the USPS tracking per mail piece.

useCases.title: Check and correct US addresses before mailing
useCases.text: The AI validates and standardizes up to 100 US postal addresses with USPS correction. Nothing is saved or sent.

useCases.title: Upload a document and an address list
useCases.text: The AI has Click2Mail fetch a PDF from a public link and uploads a recipient list of up to 500 addresses. It checks that the list is ready. Nothing is mailed.

useCases.title: Create a draft mailing job and request a proof
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft job from an uploaded document and address list, using the valid print options, and asks for a proof (preview PDF). Nothing is mailed or charged.

useCases.title: Submit a draft job for printing and mailing
useCases.text: The AI reads the exact cost and your credit, and submits the draft only after your explicit OK. Submitting charges the account and mails to every recipient.
